title: Welcome to Emix
intro: Emix brings your conversations together in one place. Stay connected with friends through private messaging, voice calls, high-quality video, and screen sharing.
intro2: Whether you're gaming, hanging out, or sharing your screen, Emix makes it easy to stay connected.

voice.title: Voice Chat
voice.body: Talk with friends in real time.

screen.title: Screen Sharing
screen.body: Share games, applications, or your entire screen.

messages.title: Private Messaging
messages.body: Keep your conversations organized and accessible.

communities.title: Communities
communities.body: Create spaces and channels for your friends.
